# Visafoto.com

> > Visafoto.com provides automated online photo tools for visa, passport, ID card, and document photos with background removal and size conversion for over 100 countries.

The service generates compliant biometric photos for government documents including passports, visas, national ID cards, driver's licenses, and specialized documents like CNIC (Pakistan), Garda age cards (Ireland), and firearms licenses (Canada). All photos meet official requirements for dimensions, background color, file size, and biometric standards.

## Key Topics

- Biometric photo requirements
- Passport photo tool
- Visa photo specifications
- 35x45mm photo format
- Background removal service
- Document photo compliance
- Photo size converter
- Online photo tool
- ID card photo generator
- Government document photos
- Photo dimensions (35x45mm, 40x60mm, 492x610px)
- White/light/colored backgrounds
- File size optimization
- International photo standards
- Digital photo submission
